h:
ComfyUI 的此工作流程采用主题图像，执行简单的背景删除，并将其覆盖到背景上。主题和背景都可以使用 loras 进行调整，两者都有可以成组绕过的控制网。现在它已为 PonyXL 设置，但您可以将任何模型插入其中，只需确保将所有控制网/loras 更改为适当的模型即可。

图像合成区域具有 X 和 Y 控件，以及前景主题的缩放。我建议进行一些初步测试以获得正确的定位。您可以更改为随机化或固定化的所有 ksampler 集都有一个全局种子。

合成图像后，将创建合成深度图，以便合并图像的 Hiresfix 通道保留深度。有一些图像控件可以调整深度蒙版（主要使用对比度和亮度来调整，您希望前景主体总体上比背景深度蒙版更亮）。

下一步是终极升级 - 如果您使用 1.5 型号，请务必将图块尺寸更改为更合适的尺寸。根据需要调整缩放比例，但我建议在此步骤中调整为 1.5 倍到 2.5 倍。缩放得越大，将降噪值调整得越高（从 0.2 到 0.3，具体取决于您的型号和 loras）。

最后一步是 FaceDetailer - 例如，如果您尝试制作特定角色，则可以将可选的 Lora 应用于 FaceDetailer。

有一些默认情况下会被绕过的可选组，您可以重新激活并重新添加：
- 主题背景删除 - 它还为主题添加彩色背景，如果您有繁忙的源图像，这很有用。
- IC 灯光 - 默认情况下它只是使用合成图像来重新照明，这会产生烧伤效果，如果您想更改它，您将必须手动添加自己的照明贴图。
- Handfix - 默认情况下禁用，因为需要大量的努力才能使其正常工作

o.en:
This workflow for ComfyUI takes a subject image, does a simple background remove, and overlays it onto a background. Both subject and background can be tuned with loras, both have controlnets that can be bypassed in groups. Right now it's set up for PonyXL but you can plug any model into it, just be sure to change ALL the controlnets/loras to appropriate models.

The image composite area has X and Y controls, plus scaling of the foreground subject. I recommend doing some initial tests to get the positioning right. There's a global seed for all the ksamplers set that you change to randomize or fixed.

After compositing the images, a composite depth-map is created, so that the Hiresfix pass to merge the images preserves the depth. There's some image controls to adjust the depth mask (using contrast and brightness primarily to tweak, you want the foreground subject to be brighter overall than the background depthmask).

Next step is Ultimate Upscale - if you're using a 1.5 model, be sure to change the tile size down to something more appropriate. Adjust the scaling as you like, but I recommend between 1.5x to 2.5x at this step. Adjust the denoise value higher the greater you scale it (from 0.2 to 0.3, depending on your model and loras).

Last step is FaceDetailer - there's an optional Lora you can apply to facedetailer, if you're trying to make a particular character, for example.

There are optional groups that are bypassed by default that you can reactivate and add back in:
- Subject Background remove - it also adds a color background to the subject, useful if you have a busy source image.
- IC lIght - by default it simply uses the composited image to relight, which does a burn effect, you will have to manually add in your own lighting map if you want to change it.
- Handfix - disabled by default because it takes a lot of futzing to make it work right
